gloss: at one's own pace; unhurried and unaffected by others

definitions.gloss: doing things at one's own pace and in one's own way, regardless of others
definitions.explanation: A Japanese coinage from 'my' and 'pace': going about things at one's own speed and manner without being swayed by the people around. Mildly admiring (steady, unflappable) or mildly critical (oblivious, slow), depending on tone. Used as a な-adjective (マイペースな{人|ひと}) and with で (マイペースで{進|すす}める).

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧マイペースな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: He does things at his own pace.

examples.japanese: マイペース⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{続|つづ}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I keep studying at my own pace.

examples.japanese: ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{急|いそ}いでいて→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{妹|いもうと}→妹：00573_imouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧マイペースだ。
examples.english: No matter how much everyone around her hurries, my sister always goes at her own pace.

notes:
A ⟦{和製英語|わせいえいご}→和製英語：18947_waseieigo⟧ (Japanese-made English) word. 'My' here means anyone's own: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧マイペースだ says he goes at his own pace, not mine.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- マイペースな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person who goes at their own pace
- マイペース⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧: to proceed at one's own pace
- マイペース⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}さない→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧: not to be knocked off one's own rhythm

USAGE:
As a description of character it is one of the standard Japanese personality labels, alongside ⟦{真面目|まじめ}→真面目：01206_majime⟧ and ⟦のんびり→のんびり：01596_nonbiri⟧; whether it is praise or a complaint depends on the speaker.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦のんびり→のんびり：01596_nonbiri⟧: relaxed, leisurely — slowness without the note of independence
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}{勝手|かって}→自分勝手：19490_jibunkatte⟧: selfish, doing as one pleases — the clearly negative version
- ⟦{我|わ}が→我が〜：03971_waga⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go one's own way — the same idea as a set phrase
